reason: I already apply to campaigns on Influish, and the barter offers come straight to my DMs, so I don't see a reason to pay for another app. I might try the free version to check a dodgy offer, but I won't pay for Pro or give up 5% in the first month.
objection: Most of my collabs are barter food and cafe deals, where there's no cash to take 5% of and nothing to chase payment for. And I'm not sure I want an AI sending reminders to brands from my account when I'm trying to keep good relations with local places.
would_change_my_mind: If its counter-offer actually turned one of my barter DMs into a paid deal, I'd happily pay the 5% or ₹199.
